notes.title: Succubus Hotel Visual Update is now available! v2.0.0
notes.notes:
Succubus Hotel Visual Update is finally between us! Check out the new photos and get the game with 30% OFF before its sale ends. Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309040/Succubus_Hotel/

Regarding the gameplay, it’s still the same: a slice of life with JRPG elements. The NSFW scenes also haven’t changed. The screen resolution has changed to 1280x800.

We hope you all enjoy the new visual as well as our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/h-room/list/56436]upcoming releases[/url].

Don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/h-room]Steam page[/url] to receive the latest news.

Hentai Room Team

notes.title: Succubus Hotel FREE Visual Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, guys!

We’re so excited to reveal [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309040/Succubus_Hotel/]Succubus Hotel[/url] will receive a visual update in which all pixel art material will be updated to our own. Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37722571/960b4d89b1bc749d54370e6054072fe2a9007f64.png[/img]

This will be a free update for those who already bought the game. If you haven’t, you should do it asap because Wednesday (04/27/22) its price will increase so that we can offer you a discount when the game is updated.

This visual update will not impact the gameplay or concept arts/scenes and will happen on Thursday, May 26th.

Thank you all for supporting us and don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/h-room]Steam[/url] page. A new game will be announced within the next few days.

Hentai Room Team

notes.title: Small Patch 1.00a
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone.

I’ve received a lot of feedback on misspellings and I’ve uploaded a new build to fix a few of them. I’m still doing a review to remove them as much as I can, so I’ll upload a new build ASAP.
